name: Civfund attacker-supplied pool callback
summary: An unrestricted CivTrade function accepted an attacker contract as a Uniswap V3 pool and temporarily authorized it as the mint-callback sender. The fake pool invoked the callback 31 times, using victims' existing allowances to drain nine assets.
notes: The vulnerable contract is direct immutable code. Its runtime hash is identical at deployment and immediately before the exploit, and its exploit trace contains no delegatecall from the target.

Exact gross debits requested by the vulnerable contract's 31 transferFrom calls and reproduced by summing Transfer events from the 31 victim wallets. This includes the full victim debit for fee-on-transfer 0NE rather than only the amount received by the attacker. USDT and USDC are valued at par; all other assets use DefiLlama observations immediately before the transaction. The onchain result replaces the seed row's rounded $165,000 estimate. Later attacker transfers and swaps dispose of the same assets and are excluded.
